name: Kruger · Hoedspruit
tagline: Big Five safaris in Africa's most famous park
summary: Kruger National Park is one of Africa's largest game reserves, home to the Big Five. Base yourself near Hoedspruit or Orpheus Gate for self-drives and guided game drives, or stay in private reserves like Timbavati and Sabi Sand for leopard sightings.
seasonNote: The dry winter (May to October) is best for game viewing as animals gather at water. Summer is green, hot and great for birds and baby animals.
arrival: Fly to Hoedspruit or Kruger Mpumalanga (Nelspruit) from Johannesburg or Cape Town, or drive about 5-6 hours from Johannesburg.
gettingAround: Self-drive inside the park on paved roads, or join guided drives. Gates close at sunset.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; keep some rand for tips, car guards and park entry kiosks.
foodTip: Braai under the stars and bobotie.
buyTip: Crafts in Hoedspruit and the panorama route stalls.
baseArea: Hoedspruit, private reserves or rest camps like Satara
